pick_curve.note: Realised value over a drafted player's first four seasons (points above replacement, discounted 10% a season, seasons below replacement count zero), offensive linemen and long snappers excluded; picks from the 2008-2022 drafts. Draft slots: the NFL's draft data via nflverse's players release (from 2008; earlier slots there come from Pro Football Reference, whose terms forbid this use).

notes.value: Projected points above a replacement player over the rest of this season and the next three, discounted 10% a season, each season floored at zero; band = 10th-90th percentile.
notes.qb: Quarterbacks with a team-strength QB value are projected from it (EPA per dropback above an average QB x dropbacks per game, above the model's value for an unknown QB).
notes.salary: No salary, cap or contract enters: the only contract source we have (OverTheCap via nflverse) does not permit republishing.
notes.availability: Expected games from how often players of the position and age play the next season, and how much; injured reserve removes the next four games.
